Risk-Free VPN Service

Truly Unlimited

IPVanish offers ultimate freedom, letting you stream, download, and browse without ever hitting a data cap. This is a significant advantage for anyone looking to enjoy online activities without restrictions, providing an uninterrupted and worry-free experience. IPVanish caters to the modern digital lifestyle, allowing unmetered simultaneous connections. This enables users to establish multiple simultaneous VPN sessions across various devices. 

Whether securing your work laptop, streaming on your tablet, or protecting your smartphone privacy, IPVanish ensures all your devices can stay connected and better protected at once. This level of flexibility and convenience underscores why IPVanish is a top choice for users seeking a truly unlimited and comprehensive VPN solution.

High-Speed Global Server Network

With more than 3,400 servers spread over 150 locations worldwide, IPVanish boasts a worldwide presence. IPVanish also offers users access to over 56,000 dynamic, shared IP addresses. This expansive network is engineered to deliver the fastest connections possible, allowing users to enjoy the full benefits of VPN protection without compromising speed. 

Access to a wide range of IP addresses can increase your anonymity online, making it significantly more difficult for anyone to track your activity. Moreover, the shared IP system adds an extra layer of privacy, as activities are blended with other users. Whether you’re streaming HD videos, gaming, or simply online shopping, IPVanish’s global server network provides the speed and security you need to do so confidently and efficiently.

Ultimate Flexibility and Compatibility

IPVanish offers unparalleled flexibility, catering to various operating systems, devices, and preferences. We support multiple protocols, including WireGuard®, OpenVPN, IKEv2, and IPSec, meaning users can select the optimal level of security and speed for their connectivity needs. Whether on Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, or even Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, and beyond, IPVanish covers you, enabling a seamless VPN experience across all your devices.

With IPVanish, you can tailor your VPN connection to fit your digital lifestyle perfectly. With our split tunneling capabilities, you can fully customize your VPN setup. Decide which applications or websites run through the VPN and which access the internet directly. This can optimize your internet speeds for different activities and give you greater control over your online privacy and security.

World Class Customer Service

Our 24/7 live chat and email support mean that help is always just a few taps away, regardless of the time or day. This round-the-clock availability is a testament to IPVanish’s commitment to providing continuous, reliable assistance to its customers. 

In addition to online support channels, IPVanish offers phone support during standard business hours, providing a more personal touch for those who prefer speaking directly with a support representative. This blend of options underscores our dedication to customer satisfaction. We offer personalized and efficient solutions to any issue that may arise so users can maintain a smooth and secure online experience.

Strict Data Privacy Practices

IPVanish is committed to strict data privacy practices, as outlined in our zero-traffic-logs privacy policy. This policy means none of your online traffic is recorded while you use our VPN service, creating a truly private browsing experience. What sets IPVanish apart is that this policy has been independently verified by a team of third-party cybersecurity experts, providing an added layer of trust and transparency. 

This independent audit confirms that IPVanish is unwavering in our commitment to user privacy, adhering to stringent data protection standards. Users can be confident that their online traffic is not monitored or stored, reinforcing IPVanish’s position as a trusted leader in the VPN industry for those who prioritize privacy.

Risk-Free VPN Service

We stand behind the quality of our VPN service, so we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on our Yearly and 2-Year plans. This policy allows users to make sure IPVanish VPN meets their needs. Whether you’re looking for speed, security, or server availability, you can explore all the features of IPVanish with the peace of mind that you can get a full refund within the first month if it doesn’t meet your expectations.

Besides the money-back guarantee, IPVanish provides a 7-day free trial on iOS and Android. This gives mobile users a convenient way to assess the service before fully committing. The trial period is a perfect opportunity to experience firsthand how IPVanish can enhance your online security, privacy, and access to digital content and confirm you are delighted with your VPN service before purchasing.

How customers use IPVanish

1

Increase Privacy on Public Wi-Fi

While public Wi-Fi may seem convenient, it’s dangerous by default. These easy-to-access, free-to-use hotspots are also a hotbed for hackers. The open network settings of public Wi-Fi networks mean anyone within range can use them, and those with a bit of tech-savvy can eavesdrop on other users. Network owners can easily view individual traffic and, in some cases, may even manipulate it. Worse still, public Wi-Fi is a popular environment for various attacks, including evil twin attacks and man-in-the-middle attacks.

So, public Wi-Fi networks aren’t safe to use without additional security measures. That’s where a VPN comes into play. IPVanish makes any network safer by encrypting your connection to the network. This helps shield your traffic from onlookers like fellow network users, network owners, and hackers.

Show more

2

Limit ISP Tracking and Throttling

Your ISP facilitates your internet access. Therefore, they play a prominent role in your online experience. However, that role isn’t always a positive one. Because they act as a facilitator, your ISP is uniquely positioned to monitor everything you do online, including browsing history, digital communications, and data usage. Their involvement doesn’t end there, however. They also have a role to play in your internet speed. If your ISP observes you using significant bandwidth, they may throttle or intentionally slow down your connection.

ISP throttling is frustrating at the best of times. It’s incredibly annoying when trying to access your favorite streaming services or online gaming platforms. Fortunately, IPVanish helps shield your online activity from your ISP, which increases your privacy and limits throttling. Whether watching the latest series on Netflix, streaming the game on ESPN+, or going for the Ultimate Team title, IPVanish delivers a smoother, more stable experience. 

Show more

3

Combat Overzealous Censorship

Repressive government actions and institutional policies often interfere with an open internet. In some regions, aggressive filtering wrongfully denies citizens access to vital online services. Similarly, firewalls implemented in workplaces and schools can restrict means of entry to legitimate websites, which stifles research, learning, and productivity.

IPVanish addresses these challenges head-on. By encrypting a device’s internet traffic and rerouting it through servers in different locations, IPVanish combats unjust restrictions imposed by local censors and network administrators, ensuring that essential services and information remain accessible. This empowers individuals to reclaim their right to privacy and restores access to information, free from the constraints of overreaching censorship.

Show more
